PRODUCT OVERVIEW

About the Border Disk

A Border Disk positions angled discs to draw soil into a raised border. Farmers use borders to divide a field into manageable sections and support a planned irrigation layout. The intended border height and soil conditions determine the appropriate adjustment.

Common field uses

  • Forming field borders
  • Defining irrigation sections
  • Maintaining existing soil ridges
IN THE FIELD

How it works

  1. 01

    Angled discs cut and gather soil.

  2. 02

    Soil is moved toward the border line.

  3. 03

    A raised boundary is formed along the pass.
